name: consent-banner
description: Styled cookie/consent banner: fixed bottom bar with accept, decline and an optional manage-preferences action. Pair it with the headless useConsent hook so the decision persists per-purpose in localStorage.
designIntent: Every consumer app reinvents the same cookie banner and consent store. ConsentBanner owns the presentation (fixed bar, safe-area padding, labelled region, AA buttons); useConsent owns the headless state (per-purpose preferences, expiry, cross-tab sync) so neither side is coupled to the other.

props.name: onAccept
props.description: Called when the visitor accepts; typically consent.setAll(true).

props.name: onDecline
props.description: Called when the visitor declines; typically consent.setAll(false).

props.name: onManage
props.description: Optional manage-preferences action for granular consent dialogs.

props.name: title
props.description: Banner heading; omit for a single-line notice.

props.name: children
props.description: Body copy; put privacy-policy links here.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the banner region.

examples.title: Accept/decline with useConsent
examples.description: The canonical wiring: render while undecided, persist through the hook.

examples.title: Gate analytics on a purpose
examples.description: Read the same hook elsewhere to gate trackers; instances stay in sync.

antiPatterns.title: Don't render before the decision is known
antiPatterns.explanation: Render the banner only while consent.decided is false, and read preferences (not decided) to gate trackers — a denied purpose and an undecided visitor are different states.

antiPatterns.title: Don't block the page
antiPatterns.explanation: ConsentBanner is non-modal by design; a modal consent wall hurts conversion and accessibility. Use Dialog only if your policy genuinely requires it.

accessibility.userRequirements: Localize label, acceptLabel, declineLabel and manageLabel for non-English audiences

accessibility.implementation: All actions are native Buttons with visible focus rings; tab order is manage → decline → accept
accessibility.userRequirements: Keep accept and decline equally prominent — no dark patterns

accessibility.implementation: Bottom padding includes env(safe-area-inset-bottom) for notched devices

compositionRules.relationship: Headless hook exported from @slipstream-ui/core; wire onAccept/onDecline/onManage to setAll/set/clear
Re-open the banner or preferences dialog from a footer 'Cookie settings' link via consent.clear()
